# AWS Private CA

Store private certificate authorities, their revocation settings and tags as records without any cryptography.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `acmpca` |
| Signing name | `acm-pca` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2017-08-22` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 9 of 23 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-private-ca) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Authorities stay PENDING_CERTIFICATE: no key pair is generated and no certificate is imported or issued, so none becomes ACTIVE or DISABLED through the API (ImportCertificateAuthorityCertificate, GetCertificateAuthorityCsr, GetCertificateAuthorityCertificate, IssueCertificate, GetCertificate and RevokeCertificate are not implemented).
- UpdateCertificateAuthority also changes the revocation settings of a PENDING_CERTIFICATE authority, although the API reference says the authority must be ACTIVE or DISABLED, so that infrastructure code can configure revocation before a certificate is installed; its status can be changed only from ACTIVE or DISABLED.
- No CRL generation, S3 writes, OCSP responder, audit reports (CreateCertificateAuthorityAuditReport), permissions, resource policies or CA sharing; ListCertificateAuthorities ResourceOwner OTHER_ACCOUNTS is always empty.
- CsrExtensions, CustomAttributes, CrlType, CustomPath and CrlDistributionPointExtensionConfiguration are rejected as not implemented; Serial, NotBefore, NotAfter and FailureReason are never returned.
- CREATING, EXPIRED and FAILED authorities are never produced, no quota (LimitExceededException) is enforced, and a CRL bucket is only checked for existence, not for a bucket policy.
- CloudFormation CertificateSigningRequest cannot be produced: Fn::GetAtt of it fails template validation; CertificateAuthorityActivation and Certificate resources are not supported.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
